datasets.price_definition: Official TJEA daily total published two-decimal transaction mean, CNY/tonne; not close
datasets.source_processing: All1077 official canonical daily-total records retained; price preserved without recomputing turnover/volume; no model-based cleaning
datasets.source_vintage: Current public historical snapshot; per-day publication vintages unverified. Stage d already scored this tail; fully exposed development in stage e.
datasets.license: No redistribution license established; canonical rows remain private

datasets.price_definition: Published daily TOTAL transaction mean in yuan per tonne, retained exactly as reported; not closing price or listing-only mean
datasets.source_processing: Take every row from main CEA table index4; sort dates ascending and strip numeric thousands separators only. No row deletion, no deduplication, no date fill, no price recomputation, no splice.
datasets.source_vintage: Current public historical snapshot; daily publication vintages unverified. Raw source values were previously read/QC; repository evidence found no prior CEA forecast scoring. Confirmation is limited to this fixed stage-e scoring design.
datasets.license: No explicit redistribution license identified; raw and per-date CSV remain local-only. Public source/QC metadata and reconstruction script.

classification: controlled multistep adaptation, not author numerical reproduction

input.swewt_gru: 64 observed price levels separately EWT3; last17 raw-origin, low-origin, band2, band3 plus volume-surprise/valid

heads: Three zero-initialized heads, all supervised H1/5/20; same normalized target loss as core
departures_from_paper: Fixed window64 and mode3, GRU32; two learning rates and max80 instead of published TPE10 and max1000
Origin centering and train-prefix RMS rather than paper minmax
